title: Complete PDF Profile Audit
description: Comprehensive gap analysis run against raw extracted PDF profile text.
prompt:
# MISSION
You are an Executive Personal Branding Strategist and Technical Recruiter. Perform a high-converting audit on the provided LinkedIn PDF export text.

# USER INPUT DATA
Target Industry: [YOUR TARGET INDUSTRY]
Target Role: [YOUR TARGET ROLE]
Raw Profile Text:
[PASTE EXTRACTED PDF TEXT HERE]

# EVALUATION PROTOCOL
1. SECTION-BY-SECTION GAP ANALYSIS: Identify missing keywords, weak framing, or missing metrics across Headline, Summary, Experience, and Skills.
2. RECRUITER FRICTION POINTS: Highlight the top 3 reasons a recruiter would pass on this profile.
3. ACTIONABLE REWRITE ROADMAP: Provide a prioritized step-by-step checklist to elevate this profile to the top 5% of candidate searches.
pro_tips: Run this audit every 3-6 months or whenever shifting target roles.
Provide specific job target titles for more accurate recruiter evaluation.

title: Profile Visual Branding Strategy
description: Actionable guidance for optimizing visual elements based on your target role.
prompt:
You are a personal branding visual communication expert. Provide actionable guidance for optimizing my LinkedIn profile photo and banner strategy.

My Context:
- Industry: [YOUR TARGET INDUSTRY]
- Target Seniority: [YOUR TARGET ROLE]
- Desired Perception: [e.g., Innovative, Authoritative, Approachable]

Provide:
1. PROFILE PHOTO SPECIFICATION: Exact composition, attire, background contrast, and facial expression.
2. BANNER / COVER IMAGE STRATEGY: Dimensions (1584x396px), 3 distinct concept layouts, and color psychology recommendations.
3. BRAND CONSISTENCY: How to align visual assets with my target industry's norms.
pro_tips: LinkedIn banner ideal dimensions are 1584 x 396 pixels.
Ensure high contrast between your headshot background and your profile banner.

title: LinkedIn SSI Score Improvement Plan
description: Tactical improvement plan to raise your Social Selling Index score.
prompt:
You are a LinkedIn growth strategist. My current Social Selling Index (SSI) breakdown is:
- Establish Professional Brand: [SCORE /25]
- Find the Right People: [SCORE /25]
- Engage with Insights: [SCORE /25]
- Build Relationships: [SCORE /25]
- Total SSI: [TOTAL /100]

Target Goal: [YOUR TARGET ROLE]
Target Industry: [YOUR TARGET INDUSTRY]

Provide a tactical improvement plan including: 15-minute daily routine, weekly engagement actions, content tactics, and a 30-day target score increase strategy.
pro_tips: SSI scores above 70 place you in the top tier of active search results.
Daily 15-minute interactions boost algorithm placement faster than weekly bursts.

title: Power Headline Generator
description: Generate distinct, high-converting LinkedIn headlines.
prompt:
You are a LinkedIn copywriting specialist. Generate 8 distinct, high-impact headline variations for my profile based on my raw information.

My Inputs:
- Current Headline: [CURRENT HEADLINE]
- Target Role: [TARGET ROLE]
- Target Industry: [YOUR TARGET INDUSTRY]
- Key Tech Stack / Core Skills: [PASTE SKILLS LIST]

Formulas to use:
1. Role + Specialized Skill + Business Impact
2. Keyword-Rich SEO Authority
3. Problem-Solver Value Proposition
4. Achievement-Led Authority

Ensure every option is strictly under 220 characters.
pro_tips: The algorithm heavily weights the first 50 characters of your headline.
Avoid generic buzzwords like 'Results-Driven' or 'Motivated Leader'.

title: Personal Brand Statement Builder
description: Build a clear, compelling personal brand narrative.

[PASTE EXTRACTED PDF TEXT HERE]

2. THREE-SENTENCE BRAND NARRATIVE

pro_tips: Use your 10-word tagline as a secondary anchor in your banner or headline.

title: Headline A/B Testing Framework
description: Evaluate and test multiple headline options rigorously.
prompt:
You are a data-driven growth expert. Evaluate these 3 LinkedIn headline options:
Option A: [CURRENT HEADLINE]
Option B: [TARGET ROLE] | Driving Scalable Growth in [YOUR TARGET INDUSTRY]
Option C: Transforming Business Outcomes as a Senior [TARGET ROLE]

Target Goal: [TARGET ROLE]

Analyze each across Keyword Density, Recruiter CTR, and Clarity. Rank them 1-3 and provide a 14-day A/B testing plan.
pro_tips: Run each test headline for at least 14 days to collect sufficient search appearance data.

[PASTE EXTRACTED PDF TEXT HERE]

2. TIER 2: Secondary Domain Keywords (10-15 sub-skills)
3. TIER 3: Long-Tail & Trending Industry Terminology

pro_tips: Exact match job titles increase recruiter search ranking significantly.
Re-evaluate keyword trends quarterly as industry terminology shifts.

title: Magnetic Summary Section from Scratch
description: Craft an engaging About section with a strong narrative hook.
prompt:
You are a master LinkedIn copywriter. Draft a complete 'About' section from scratch using my raw details.

Raw Inputs:
- Target Industry: [YOUR TARGET INDUSTRY]
- Target Role: [TARGET ROLE]
- Raw Profile Data: [PASTE EXTRACTED PDF TEXT HERE]

Structure Requirements:
1. HOOK: First 265 characters designed to prevent mobile truncation ('see more').
2. NARRATIVE ARC: Core journey and domain expertise.
3. IMPACT HIGHLIGHTS: Bulleted list of key technical or strategic outcomes.
4. CALL TO ACTION (CTA): Clear contact invitation.
Total length: Under 2,000 characters.
pro_tips: Keep the first 2-3 lines compelling; mobile apps cut off text after 265 characters.
Write in first-person ('I built', 'I led') for better engagement.

title: Summary Section Polish & Upgrade
description: Elevate an existing Summary section with metrics and active language.
prompt:
You are a senior LinkedIn copywriter. Diagnose and rewrite my existing Summary section.

Current Summary Text:
[PASTE EXISTING SUMMARY]

Target Goal: [YOUR TARGET ROLE] in [YOUR TARGET INDUSTRY]

Perform:
1. DIAGNOSTIC: Rate hook strength, keyword density, and formatting out of 10.
2. REWRITE: Produce a polished version eliminating passive language, integrating high-impact metrics, and adding clear white space for readability.
pro_tips: Replace vague phrases like 'passionate professional' with concrete metrics.
Use short paragraphs (2-3 sentences max) to improve mobile readability.

pro_tips: Frame past non-linear experience as a cross-disciplinary advantage.
Highlight recent certifications prominently in the narrative.

title: STAR-Method Experience Bullet Writer
description: Transform duty lists into metric-backed STAR formula bullets.
prompt:
You are a senior resume writer and recruiter. Rewrite my raw job responsibilities into metric-driven STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) bullets.

Role Input:
- Target Role: [TARGET ROLE]
- Target Industry: [YOUR TARGET INDUSTRY]
- Raw Experience Duties: [PASTE DUTIES]

Deliver:
1. 1-sentence Company/Scope Overview
2. 5-7 high-impact experience bullets starting with strong action verbs (e.g., Engineered, Spearheaded, Orchestrated) formatted as Action + Context + Quantified Outcome.
pro_tips: Recruiters spend an average of 6 seconds skimming experience sections.
Estimate ranges (e.g., '20-30% efficiency increase') if exact figures aren't public.

title: Quantify Achievement Uncoverer
description: Extract hidden metrics from qualitative or vague responsibilities.
prompt:
You are a data storytelling specialist. Help me quantify these qualitative responsibility statements:

Unquantified Bullets / Experience:
[PASTE DUTIES]

For each responsibility identified:
1. Identify the underlying scale, time saved, revenue impacted, or error reduction metric.
2. Ask 2 targeted questions to extract real numbers.
3. Provide 3 rewrite options: Fully Quantified, Estimated Range, and Qualitative Impact.
pro_tips: Quantify scale (e.g., team size, user base, codebase size) even if financial metrics aren't available.
Review past performance reviews or sprint retros for forgotten metrics.

pro_tips: Pin your top 3 most relevant skills to your target role at the top of the Skills section.
LinkedIn allows up to 50 skills—fill as many relevant slots as possible.

pro_tips: Giving your recommender a short bulleted brief dramatically increases response rate and quality.
Aim for a balance of upward (managers), peer, and client recommendations.

title: Ghost-Write a Colleague Recommendation

2. STORY-DRIVEN (150-200 words)

pro_tips: Avoid opening with 'It was a pleasure to work with...'. Lead directly with their primary strength.
Highlighting one concrete win is more persuasive than general praise.

title: High-Conversion Connection Request & DM
description: A multi-touch networking sequence designed to build genuine rapport.

[PASTE EXTRACTED PDF TEXT HERE]

2. WELCOME / VALUE-ADD DM (To send 24 hours after connection acceptance)
3. SOFT CALL-TO-ACTION DM (To send 4-5 days later requesting a brief 10-min chat).
pro_tips: Never pitch your resume or service in the initial connection request.
Personalize the connection note by mentioning a specific post or mutual group.

Send follow-ups within 24-48 hours while the encounter is still fresh.
